title: Katocraft Hardcore
description: A visual overhaul and QoL modpack made for the katocraft hardcore server
body:
KatoSynn’s Hardcore Visual & QoL Pack is a lightweight Minecraft modpack built specifically for our community’s hardcore server. It focuses on enhancing the game’s visuals and quality-of-life features without changing core gameplay or balance.

This pack keeps the vanilla hardcore experience intact while making the world feel smoother, clearer, and more immersive. Expect improved lighting, cleaner UI, performance-friendly visual tweaks, and small QoL improvements that reduce frustration without removing challenge.

Designed to be simple, stable, and easy to run, this modpack is perfect for long-term hardcore survival where every detail matters—and every life counts.
